name: mccia-approvals
description: MCCIA internal approval system: expenditure, DG approvals, HR, reimbursement and events

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:ui
